reviews.review:
I want to love the game but I can't.
It's been presented to me as a "balatro with dices". Indeed you can modify the faces, you have relics and you can repaint your dices.
Pro:
The Idea
Con:
-There is no enough incentive to go outside the base 1to6 faces. Negative or giant values are hard to get and do not have enough relic/consumable synergies to be viable
-The inflation system makes it impossible to have a "I broke the game" feeling.
-Locking the shop costs golds but unless you have a good economy generation, you don't generate enough gold to even have more golds than before locking it.
-The game becomes repetitive very fast
-The boss debuffs can be as hard to pass as "well end of run".

TLDR: Looks like a game that has lots of options but is still in alpha with lots of unexplored areas.
